summary: First full test run of Padaria POS. Backend: 25 pytest cases (auth password+PIN, role 403s, product CRUD w/ variations, comanda add/remove/checkout w/ change, pizza half-half, required variations, fiado checkout+limit+payment+history, encomendas, estoque movements+alerts, dashboard, users CRUD) -> 21 pass, 4 fail (edge-case bugs). Frontend (Playwright, desktop 1920): PIN + password login, operador route guards (redirect to /caixa, gerente nav hidden), Caixa POS full flow (simple product, Pizza Grande half-half, X-Burger extras+qty, multi-cash payment w/ troco R$7,50, receipt), fiado sale via UI (button disabled w/o customer, debt updated, Receber reduces balance, history shows venda+pagamento), Encomendas create + status change, Estoque create/saida/entrada + low-stock banner, Cardapio create w/ variation/edit/delete, Usuarios create/edit/delete, Dashboard KPIs, Comandas tabs + receipt. Core flows all work. Main issues: mobile layout completely broken, encomendas cannot handle products with required variations, pizza extras not priced by backend, dashboard 'dinheiro' includes troco, regex crash in customer search, negative payment accepted.

critical.issue: _build_item: when product.is_pizza=True, product.variations (e.g. Borda/Extras) are ignored -> price_delta not added and text not stored. Frontend ProductDialog shows base+extras (e.g. R$58) but server charges R$50. Cardapio editor allows adding variations to pizzas. Verified with probe_pizza_extras.py. Fix: also call _format_variations for pizzas.
por_pagamento sums payment.amount including troco: R$4 sale paid with R$10 cash -> dinheiro +10 while faturamento +4. Use amount - change for dinheiro.

minor.issue: 500 Internal Server Error - regex not escaped. Use re.escape(q).
Negative amount accepted (amount=-50 increases debt to 50). Validate amount > 0 (Pydantic Field(gt=0)). Same for Payment.amount, OrderItemIn.quantity, EstoqueMovimentoIn.quantity, discount.
Duplicate PIN allowed (created user with PIN 1234 same as admin) -> PIN login returns first match = ambiguous/wrong user. Also PIN not validated as 4 digits.

Fiado debt updates are applied in loop before other validations of later fiado payments -> partial debt write if second fiado payment fails (non-atomic). Also fiado overpayment (amount > total) is booked fully as debt.
'today' computed in UTC: sales after 21:00 Brasília count as next day; encomendas_hoje uses UTC date too.
JWT_SECRET has hardcoded fallback default; no endpoint to delete/void test or erroneous closed orders.

ui_bugs.issue: Sidebar is fixed w-64 with no responsive collapse/drawer. At 390px content is clipped, document scrollWidth=562 (horizontal overflow); Caixa product grid not visible at all on mobile.

No variation selector for items. Products with required variations (Bolo de Fubá - Tamanho, Pastel - Recheio, Suco Natural) cannot be added: save shows toast 'Selecione Tamanho'. Ordering a whole cake (core bakery pre-order) impossible.
Alert count fetched only once on login; after estoque saída making item low, banner says 2 items but topbar/sidebar badge stays 1 until reload.
Pizza item shows 'Sabores: Calabresa / Mussarela' twice (variations_text + pizza_halves both rendered).
navigate() called during render -> React console error 'Cannot update a component while rendering a different component'. Use <Navigate> or useEffect.
Delete customer trash icon shown to operador but backend DELETE /customers is gerente-only (403).
Default delivery_date uses new Date().toISOString() (UTC) -> after 21:00 local defaults to tomorrow.

integration_issues.issue: ProductDialog total includes variation deltas for pizza but backend ignores them -> displayed price != charged price.

issues: Sonner toasts top-right overlap the topbar (stock alert badge / user name) and 'Pedido atual' header in Caixa; consider bottom-right
Cardápio nav uses UserCog icon (people icon) - unrelated to menu
Login page shows test credentials hint 'admin/admin123 · caixa1/caixa123' - remove for production
Native <input type=date>/<time> used in Encomendas instead of shadcn Calendar/Popover
Pizza dialog text says 'Valor cobrado é do sabor mais caro' but flavors have no individual prices (pizza_pricing unused)
Encomenda card shows leading ' · 08:00' when phone empty
Many products without image fall back to letter tiles (ok) but Coxinha seed image looks unrelated (green dish)

action_items: Make layout responsive: collapsible sidebar/drawer (hamburger) on <md, stack Caixa product grid and order panel on mobile
Add variation selectors (reuse ProductDialog) in Encomendas item rows so required variations can be chosen
Backend _build_item: apply product.variations price deltas/text for pizza products too
Dashboard por_pagamento: subtract change from dinheiro amounts
Validate positive amounts/quantities with Pydantic (Field(gt=0)) for fiado payments, checkout payments, items, estoque movements, discount >= 0
Reject duplicate PINs and enforce 4-digit PIN on create/update user
Refresh stock alert count in Layout after estoque changes (context/event or refetch on route change)
Remove duplicate 'Sabores' line in Caixa item list and ReceiptDialog
Hide customer delete button for operador
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1216 lines - split into routers (auth, users, products, orders, fiado, estoque, encomendas, dashboard)
Checkout is non-atomic: fiado debt writes happen before all payments validated; stock decremented after order closed without checks
Dashboard loads ALL closed orders and filters in Python (to_list(2000)) - will truncate/slow; use date range query on closed_at
PIN login iterates bcrypt over all users (O(n) bcrypt) - fine for small staff but combine with unique-PIN constraint
PATCH /encomendas accepts raw dict body without Pydantic model; status values not validated; PATCH /orders status not validated
DELETE /products hard-deletes - historic orders keep product_name so ok, but consider soft delete (active=false) which already exists
JWT_SECRET fallback default should be removed (fail fast)

Many interactive elements lack data-testid: encomenda status select & delete, user edit/delete buttons, variation editor inputs in Cardapio, payment row remove button, estoque quantity/min inputs, comanda status buttons
test_credentials: admin/admin123 PIN 1234 (gerente); caixa1/caixa123 PIN 5678 (operador) - all verified working
seed_data_creation: All TEST_ customers, products, estoque items, encomendas, users created were deleted by id. Open test comandas were cancelled (incl. #111 'Mesa 1'). NOTE: ~8 closed TEST_ orders (#101-#110, table_label TEST_*) remain because there is no delete endpoint -> today's dashboard faturamento (~R$260) includes test sales; fiado_mov/estoque_mov history entries for deleted TEST_ records remain. Seed data not modified.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: cd /app/backend && REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=... python -m pytest tests/test_pos_api.py (pytest.ini uses xdist). 4 expected failures until fixed: regex search, negative payment, dashboard cash incl. troco, duplicate PIN. probe_pizza_extras.py should print total 58 after fix. Retest mobile (390px) layout and Encomendas with Bolo de Fubá 'Bolo inteiro'. Toasts use [data-sonner-toast]. Selects are shadcn (click trigger then get_by_role('option')).
rca of the issue: Pizza extras: _build_item has if/else on is_pizza, variations only handled in else branch. Dashboard cash: aggregates p['amount'] without subtracting p['change']. Mobile: Layout aside has fixed w-64 + shrink-0 with no breakpoint classes. Encomendas: item row only renders product Select, qty and pizza flavors; variations_data stays {} so backend _format_variations raises 400 for required ones. Regex: user input passed directly to $regex.
